title: Every Exam Question Stayed Identical, Yet One Cover Line Tanked Scores
description:
You think hard exams simply measure what students already know! Yet one cover sentence drained bright test scores right away! This is the true story of Claude Steele at Stanford University. Here is what went wrong inside a quiet Stanford classroom.
